messages:
elaine: quick postmortem follow-up — link to doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-20-memory-kv-eviction. TL;DR: recurring kv-eviction under 99th pct tail when sustained >1k rps. we agreed on remediation items; posting action decomposition and asking for test/owner commitments.
vikram: i'll take ownership of the KV eviction regression test (implementation + CI gating). target: feature branch infra by EOW. :+1:
jamal: QA can own promptset regression additions. i'll add the two failing prompt families (short-context split, streaming truncation) to the nightly promptset run. ETA next Tue.
taylor: can we also add a targeted load test profile that reproduces the >1k sustained pattern? says it's different from our normal spike test.
sam: yes — propose a new scenario in k6: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 1h --rps 1000 --out influxdb` (we'll add a small ramp). i'll push the scenario and a helm value to spawn dedicated worker nodes.
vikram: for the regression harness, plan: (1) reproduce locally with `make repro-kv-eviction`, (2) add a gtest that simulates long-lived kv cache, (3) integrate into regression-suite with `CI_TAG=kv-eviction`. anyone object?
jamal: no objections. also adding the failing model/overlay combos to the eval harness so we catch model + quantization regressions.
taylor: timeline check — remediation code + unit tests by 2026-03-29, regression + load scenario in CI by 2026-04-05, promptset added to nightly by 2026-03-30. are those OK?
ev-ops: ops-bot: reminder scheduled: @channel run chaos drill checklist on 2026-04-06 — drill owner: vikram.
vikram: noted. for the chaos drill i'd like to verify: KV eviction under memory pressure, node preemption fallback, and fallback routing to lower-capacity model variant. we'll script everything in `ops/chaos/kv-eviction-playbook.md`.
jamal: calling out alerting: add a synthetic 99th pct monitor for `kv.evictions` and an SLA regression alert that pages SRE if baseline increases >30% relative to weekly avg.
sam: tagging eng-sre for help on alert thresholds: @eng-sre please advise on paging thresholds.
ops-bot: @vikram assigned remediation-ticket RED-2134 to vikram (due 2026-03-29).
taylor: action list summary —
- vikram: repro + unit tests + chaos drill orchestration (due 2026-03-29)
- sam: load scenario + helm values + CI job (due 2026-04-05)
- jamal: promptset additions + eval harness updates + nightly job (due 2026-03-30)
- eng-sre: advise on paging thresholds + add 99th pct synthetic check (TBD)
please react with :white_check_mark: when you've started work so we can move into the sprint board. i'll create the sprint card and link these tickets.
vikram: started — leaving a short note on the ticket with repro steps. :rocket:
jamal: started — added placeholder tests to the promptset repo.
sam: ETA for PR for load scenario is tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: closing note: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-04-01 10:00am PT in #eng-platform.
